title: oenothera biennis var. muricata
intro: Oenothera biennis var. muricata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a plant species within the Onagraceae family, native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in relieving symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and mood swings, due to its high content of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions like eczema, arthritis, and high cholesterol. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera biennis var. muricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
